title: eat shit & die 177
author: bpatrick
html: Why did it take ’til Thursday to get this comic done? Join me in cursing my PI, won’t you? I just watched Network for the first time. Holy shit. It was so good. It left nothing but scorched earth.
postClass: post-632 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-eatshitanddie uentry post-comic postonpage-1 odd post-author-bpatrick

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: Why did it take ’til Friday for me to read this comic? Join me in cursing minimum-wage labor and the 40-hour week. Or we could be positive and join me in praising the new Curious Urgency and es&d comics that came up during my hell-week at work.

comments.author: Andrew A
comments.html:
Love this one!

And Network is one of my favorite films ever! Written by a man who didn’t shy away from ‘big words’ and deep concepts. We could do with a few more Paddy Chayefskys in the world today.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html:
@Andrew A: Thanks! Yeah, I was blown away by Network. It’s perfect. And it seems like it is mostly due to Chayefsky. I’ve never seen Altered States either but Ken Russell’s involvement makes me wary.
@bill: Thanks! And thanks for all the comments! I hope we hear more from you!
@Jonny Paycheck: Thanks, Jonny! I’ve got more Onan comin’ up for you.

comments.author: Orrange
comments.html:
I used to think that way until I really sat down and listened to some Buddhist monks I met one day in Sears. I decided that they were right. My desire was the source of all suffering and I could be relieved of it by giving it up. I also decided I didn’t want to do that. So, I live my life knowing that I live it the wrong way.

I’m loving your comic and making my way thru your archives. Partly because I’m procrastinating drawing my own, but mostly because they’re really damn good. StumbleUpon brings me a winner again.

comments.author: jomul7
comments.html: this is the type of procrastination I enjoy. Instead of writing my book, here I am thinking about the big questions of life thanks to a comic.
